description:
Draft a Privi Mandate: the human's signed permission for your agent to spend, with a budget, per-payment cap,
allowed payees and expiry. Returns sign_url: send it to the human, who reads the plain-English terms and signs
once with their wallet (free, no transaction). Nothing can be spent until they sign. Requires the organization API key.

max_per_payment_usdc.description: Cap per payment; defaults to the total
max_per_payment_usdc.title: Max Per Payment Usdc

payees.description: Allowed payees (0x addresses or domains); omit for any
payees.title: Payees

principal_wallet.description: 0x wallet of the human who authorizes the spending
principal_wallet.title: Principal Wallet

purpose.description: What the agent may spend on, in plain words
purpose.title: Purpose

stream_id.description: The agent (stream) that will spend, e.g. 'shopping-agent'
stream_id.title: Stream Id

name: mandate_create
title: Create a spending mandate
